Name: Sonic The Hedgehog 4: Episode I
Description: The blue blur returns in a classic 2D platformer that picks up where Sonic & Knuckles left off. Dash, spin and loop through four reimagined zones, collect the Chaos Emeralds and stop Dr. Eggman once again.
